:::{#def-nested-cv}
#### Nested cross-validation

**Nested cross-validation** is [$k$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold)
of the [cross-validation choice procedure](#def-cv-choice) $g^{\text{CV}}$:
its estimate on a training set $\trainset$ is

$$
\cvestof{k}{g^{\text{CV}}}\paren{\trainset}.
$$ {#eq-nested-cv}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.2] for cross-validating every step of a procedure,
choices included.
:::
